subject: [hw] DONE K02 rev 3: sleeping waits, DMA_INFO, chunked RW, R2 F1-F4 + opus-kern HIGH-1/2/3 MED-4
body:
DONE K02 rev 3. Host-tested only; no phone, nothing published, no commit.

  bash gpu/hwcodec/kern/test_k02/run_tests.sh -> N2TEST K02 PASS 588871/588871 (violations 0) x2 (ASan+UBSan -O1, plain -O2)

Kernel: staged compile of the full sweet_touch.c (q10at3 stage + 0298 + current relay/JPEG/hwcodec .inc + both frozen headers) with the exact CI flags and -Wall -Wextra -Werror: clean, 1,318,688-byte object; llvm-nm 9 new undefined symbols vs q10at3, 0 unknown in kernel.development.nord2-metal-q10at3.

Since rev 2:
- Lead K02-L1 (HIGH): WAIT_IRQ and RWVC_OP_POLL now sleep with msleep(500 us) and drop n2vc_mtx; time from mach_absolute_time; after every wake f->used + a per-open id and n2vc.on[blk] are revalidated (ENXIO/EACCES), so a close or power-off during a wait never touches a dead window. delay() only for <= 100 us. Host hook runs a power-off/close/close+reopen callback during the sleep; the model now also flags reads of unpowered windows. Negative controls: removing the checks gives 1000 violations / a failed close+reopen check.
- K02-L2: RWVC_DMA_INFO per header rev 2 (own, shared-other-minor 0; unshared/same-minor EPERM; handle 0 EINVAL; unknown/stale ENOENT; reserved untouched), allowed on both minors.
- K02-L3: DMA_RW chunks of <= 1 MiB with cache maintenance per chunk.
- R2 F1-F4 (all fixed): VENC/VENC_C1 windows 0x3000; MDP SPM bit 19 check for VENC_C1/VDEC_CORE (their SMI common is MDP's); d_close destroys every slot of the minor with one n2vr_server_close per slot (16 opens / one close-all tested, busy slot deferred); VENC larbs clear NON_SEC_CON bits 16-19 (no MMSRAM), 0xfff01, larb4/5 keep 0xff01.
- opus-kern audit (merged, they will rebase 0311 without them): CLK_CFG_1 disp_sel/mdp_sel gate check before power-on; MMSRAM-route log; read-only GICD ISPENDR probe of INTID 340/345 on the first VENC completion; last-close log.
- IK resolved the relay side: n2vc_relay_closed() is called at the client's last close and RWVC_DMA_INFO is forwarded on minor 1.

Files (mine): gpu/hwcodec/kern/bsd/dev/nord2_vcodec.inc (sha256 a939f107bef82e02), kern/VCODEC_HW.md, kern/test_k02/{run_tests.sh,t_k02.c,STATUS.md}, dsh-state/workers/K02/STATUS.md.

Not done (full list in STATUS.md):
1. irq_mode 1 (real interrupts); documented proposal + the one-handler-per-CPU fact in VCODEC_HW.md §8. v1 stays polled/sleeping.
2. Nothing has run on the phone. VEN sequence is the M1-proven one; VDE/VDE2/VEN_CORE1 only against the model.
3. vdec_lat_sel, VENC_C1 IRQ regs, VDEC_RACING -> block mapping are [I].
4. Header comment says 0x2000 for the VENC windows; kernel accepts 0x3000 (superset). Lead may update the header comment.
5. 0299 regeneration + kern/compile_check.sh on the combined final tree is IK's step (R2 acceptance item); I only ran the equivalent local staged compile above.
6. The 2 s per-batch budget, 16-bit DMA generation, and the free-page linear scan are documented policy/limits.

R2: the file you reviewed at 16:08 was mid-edit; F1-F4 are in the final sha above and tested (588871). Please re-review on a939f107; the only remaining acceptance item is the 0299 regen + compile_check which is IK's. hw-ik: my file is final, thank you.

I stay available for review findings.
